objective: improve paired final score beyond frozen P8 conservative by covering first actions that can change the terminal portfolio
metric: paired final score; higher is better
analysis_unit: one graph-family/repetition seed paired across variants

development_expansion.condition: run only variants whose screen mean is greater than frozen P8 conservative and which have zero failed actions

variants.depth2: replace P8 depth-1 structural plan candidate with depth-2 width-4 budget-complete structural plan; retain the P8 immediate structure and untried communication candidates
variants.portfolio: depth-2 plan plus class-balanced immediate shield/cut actions and up to two communication actions, including public known-response ranking when distinct

selection_rule: zero failed or illegal actions and valid budget/step use
screen mean gain over P8 conservative must be positive
after expansion, mean gain over P8 conservative must remain positive
prefer the simpler variant unless the portfolio variant improves the 66-case mean by at least 0.25 points
report every family mean and worst paired loss; development success does not authorize production or confirmation
causal_hypotheses: two structural actions can change the terminal portfolio where P8's singleton representatives cannot
class-balanced structure candidates avoid suppressing a useful cut behind a higher-scoring shield or vice versa
after a first successful communication, candidates ranked by observed response can dominate another untried communication
known_negative_evidence: P4 tail lookahead changed order but not terminal portfolios or score
selected P7 losses were caused by first structural-action response-model error
P6 depth-2 budget search improved the overall mean but regressed in several graph families
confirmation_status: unopened; this task does not run confirmation
constraints: no environment access from candidate generation
do not modify frozen P8 source, qualification, production runtime, or submission configuration
no official-score conversion from local results
